subtitle: A private pay-beach on a Curaçao plantation bay near where Tula's rebels broke a Dutch militia column on 19 August 1795.
spike_statement: On 19 August 1795, rebels led by Tula broke a 67-man Dutch militia column near this bay, the revolt's sharpest tactical defeat for the colonial government.

levers.photo_tone: Weathered coral-stone plantation ruins and flat turquoise bay water in harsh midday light, rental umbrellas and a dive-shop tower set against 18th-century fort and storehouse stone.
